title: 第三章 老太太你骗我第四章梦乎
content_zh:
第三章【老太太，你骗我……】
讲真，现在陈言已经不是单纯的奇怪和荒唐了。
而是，甚至产生了一丝忌惮和慌张。
马老板定睛看了看陈言，忽然仿佛明悟的笑了：“这样吧，陈言先生，麻烦你，给老太太带个话，就说，西湖小马，想拜见一下老太太，不知道有没有这个福缘。”
瞧瞧这称呼，西湖小马！
“呃……”
陈言心中一肚子的疑问，小心的组织语言：“老太太就在家里，我们家门也从来不锁，村里的老头老太太还没事过来顺头蒜什么的……你要见她，直接去拍门……”
马老板哈哈一笑，然后收起笑容。
“陈言先生，是这样的。
当年，老太太见的时候，就告诉过我，她的一个规矩。”
“什么规矩？”
马老板叹了口气：“老太太说，她给世俗之人算运，就只能有一面之缘。”
一面之缘？
“意思是，她和任何一个求运道的人，缘分，就只有那一次见面。
算过那一次后，这辈子都不会有第二次。
她说过，富贵命是天数，泄露天机太多，她老人家会折损阳寿的。”
马老板说的很小心，似乎努力斟酌着用词。
一面之缘？
泄露天机？
折损阳寿？

这特么全是网文的词儿啊。
不是，马老板，你是不是搞错了？
投资网文业务的是另外一个马老板，不是你啊！
马老板面色有些尴尬，也有些不好意思：“是这样的，老太太对我的那次帮助太大了！
可以说是再造之恩！
若不是当初她的那个指点……恐怕也没有今天的马某人！
总之，我事业成就后，多次想办法再求见老太太，结果都被拒绝了。”
陈言听着，心里却越发的有个让他恐惧的念头生了出来……
就听马老板叹了口气：“最近我确实遇到了一些难事，万般无奈，只好再次登门求见，只是想着，不行的话我就先找老太太家里人问问，求个面子……所以，这才冒昧让人把你请来……”
陈言手一抖！
马老板有些为难：“我知道这么说话，是有些不好听，更有些不近人情。
我这点私心……唉，这话说来，实在是惭愧！
陈言先生，对不住对不住！
我先自罚一杯！”
说着马老板就要举杯……
嗡！
从进屋开始就一直懵逼，被这一切荒唐事情弄的到现在还没回过味的陈言。
content_en:
Chapter 3 [Old lady, you lied to me...]
To be honest, Chen Yan is no longer just weird and ridiculous.
Instead, there was even a hint of fear and panic.
Boss Ma looked at Chen Yan intently, and suddenly smiled as if he understood something: "Well, Mr. Chen Yan, please give the old lady a message. Just say, Xihu Xiaoma, I want to pay a visit to the old lady. I don't know if I have such a blessing."
Look at this title, West Lake Pony!
"Uh..."
Chen Yan was full of doubts and carefully organized his words: "The old lady is at home, and our door is never locked. The old man and old lady in the village come over to meet her... If you want to see her, just go and knock on the door..."
Boss Ma laughed, then put away his smile.
"Mr. Chen Yan, this is it.
Back then, when we met, the old lady told me one of her rules. "
"What rules?"
Boss Ma sighed: "The old lady said that if she tells fortunes for secular people, she can only have a one-time relationship."
A one-sided relationship?
"It means that her fate with anyone who seeks luck is only met once.
After counting that time, there will never be a second time in this life.
She said that wealth and destiny are determined by destiny, and if she reveals too many secrets, her life will be shortened. "
Boss Ma spoke very carefully, as if he was trying hard to choose his words.
A one-sided relationship?
Leaking secrets?
Lose Yangshou?
These are all words from online literature.
No, Boss Ma, are you mistaken?
It’s another Boss Ma who invests in the online writing business, not you!
Boss Ma looked a little embarrassed and a little embarrassed: "That's right, the old lady helped me so much!
It can be said to be the gift of reinvention!
If it weren't for her guidance at the beginning... I'm afraid there wouldn't be someone like Ma today!
In short, after I became successful in my career, I tried to find ways to see the old lady again, but I was rejected every time. "
As Chen Yan listened, a more and more frightening thought came to his mind...
I heard Boss Ma sigh: "I have indeed encountered some difficulties recently. I have no choice but to come to see you again. I just thought that if it doesn't work, I will ask the old lady's family first to save face... That's why I took the liberty of inviting you here..."
Chen Yan's hand shook!
Boss Ma was a little embarrassed: "I know that speaking like this is a bit unpleasant and a bit inhumane.
My selfishness... Well, I feel really ashamed to say this!
Mr. Chen Yan, I'm sorry, I'm sorry!
I'll punish myself with a drink first! "
As he said this, Boss Ma was about to raise his glass...
Buzz!
Chen Yan has been confused since he entered the house, and has been confused by all these ridiculous things until now.
